subject: One Mission Buzz-Off for Team HEMO
overview: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke and members of the McGlynn Elementary School community announced their participation in a fundraiser to support pediatric cancer research. The initiative honors the memory of Heemo Dufourge, a former student who passed away from spinal cancer.

items.title: One Mission Buzz-Off Participation
items.summary: Mayor Burke and McGlynn Elementary staff announced they are buzzing their hair for Team HEMO at Gillette Stadium to raise funds for pediatric cancer. The event commemorates a former student and involves approximately 15 to 20 community members.
